page.overview:
Who is Carl Sanford?

Carl Sanford is a fictional character from the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. He appears in Chaosium's Call of Cthulhu role-playing game, and in Fantasy Flight Games' Arkham Horror Files-related content.

The High Priest of Arkham's Silver Twilight Lodge, Sanford is a tall, slim man with an air of breeding about him. An antiquarian by trade, he holds a degree of influence in nearly every organisation in the city. Despite his standing in the community, there are many who fear the man, and rumours abound regarding the unwholesome deeds perpetrated in both his name and that of the Lodge.

Sanford was first introduced in Shadows of Yog-Sothoth as the central antagonist, working behind the scenes of the Order of the Silver Twilight, and using other "Lords of the Silver Twilight" to raise the island of R'lyeh and possibly to even wake Cthulhu, depending on the player's intervention. Canonically, this fails, but Sanford escapes and then reappears in Masks of Nyarlathotep as a secondary antagonist in the China chapter. In Cults of Cthulhu, he is listed as an example "Deathless Master" (a leader of the global Cthulhu cult, coequal to the "deathless Chinaman" of The Call of Cthulhu, whom the book names Hui Qiang), or maybe even a direct agent of Cthulhu, but the book leaves the exact interpretation up to the Keeper.

During the events of the novel, Sanford inducted Phillip Avery into the Lodge as a way to gain the services of the Mi-Go known as Mr. Stone and his Byakhee servants. (: Feeders from Within)
